contextual_terms.source: \bWhy not fight me? It may just inspire my friend to give it another go. By the way. I'm Flint, an Elite Four member.
contextual_terms.reason: 原文明示四天王成員，指大葉。

contextual_terms.source: \bYou are not registered to fight Drake.
contextual_terms.reason: 橘子聯盟挑戰登記台詞，與取得四徽章挑戰勇次的說明一致。

retained_terms.Daroxy: 遊戲自訂島嶼名稱，與既有地圖一致保留原拼字。
